faq_heading: Homes near Douglas Park Community: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Douglas Park Community catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Douglas Park Community home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names Douglas Park Community. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 1 km away.

How the Douglas Park Community search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Douglas Park Community, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away.
